newsitem.title: USA: Allmerica closes Allmerica Property deal.
newsitem.headline: Allmerica closes Allmerica Property deal.

text.p: Allmerica Financial Corp said Wednesday it had closed its acquisition of the 40.5 percent of Allmerica Property & Casualty Cos Inc that it did not already own.
Allmerica said it bought 24.2 million shares of Allmerica Property for about $426 million cash and 9.7 million Allmerica Financial common shares.
It said it had converted all Allmerica Property shares into the right to receive $17.60 cash and 0.40 share of Allmerica Financial.
Allmerica Property shareholders may also elect to receive for each of their shares either $33 cash or 0.85714 share of Allmerica Financial.
It said the aggregate amounts of cash and stock issuable are limited, and the shareholders' elections are subject to proration.
It added it will mail merger consideration election forms to Allmerica Property shareholders within the next few days. The election deadline is August 13.
Allmerica Financial's stock hit an intra-day 52-week high of 44 today. It was trading at 43-3/8 in the afternoon, up 3/16.
